response.sql:
WITH scope_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS count_records
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_of_avgs
  FROM scope_avgs
)
SELECT 
  sa.acctscope,
  sa.avg_net_fee_rate,
  sa.count_records,
  sa.avg_net_fee_rate - om.mean_of_avgs AS distance_from_mean
FROM scope_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY sa.acctscope

assumptions.assumption: "Simple mean of the scope averages" refers to the unweighted arithmetic mean of the per-scope averages (treating each scope equally), not the overall average across all records (which would treat each record equally). If scopes have unequal record counts, these produce different results.

alternatives.interpretation: The distance represents each scope's average relative to the overall average net fee rate across all records, not relative to the mean of the scope averages. This weights scopes by their record counts.

  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS count_records
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS overall_avg
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
)
SELECT 
  sa.acctscope,
  sa.avg_net_fee_rate,
  sa.count_records,
  sa.avg_net_fee_rate - om.overall_avg AS distance_from_mean
FROM scope_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY sa.acctscope
